lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots show a gradient of increasing diameter and inter-spot distance along the dorso-ventral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from a high-luminance upper edge to a darker shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The anterior cephalic region features a high density of small, punctate high-luminance spots that transition into larger, more widely spaced blobs across the gill region.
